invalid.title: This invitation link isn't valid
invalid.body: The link may be incomplete or have been changed. Please open it again from the WhatsApp message, or ask the host to resend your invitation.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this invitation
notFound.body: The link is genuine, but the guest list isn't available here. This demo keeps its data in the browser it was created in, so open the link on the same device, or ask the host to resend it.

details.title: Event details
details.calendarNote: Downloads a calendar file you can open on your phone.

rsvp.title: Will you be joining us?
rsvp.lead: Let {hosts} know so they can prepare for you.
rsvp.confirmedTitle: You're confirmed. We can't wait to see you!
rsvp.declinedTitle: Thank you for letting us know
rsvp.declinedBody: We'll miss you. If your plans change, you can still switch your answer below.
rsvp.stopHint: Opt out of WhatsApp messages about this event.
rsvp.stoppedTitle: You won't receive any more messages
rsvp.stoppedBody: We've stopped all messages for this event. Your invitation link remains available here.
rsvp.demoNote: Demo note: in production this answer is the guest's reply on WhatsApp. These buttons simulate it.

pass.title: Show this at the entrance
pass.checkedInHint: This pass has been used. Welcome!
